Based on the search results, **Gustave Courbet** is the primary creator of "Le ruisseau noir" (also known as "Le Ruisseau du Puits Noir" or "The Black Creek"). His birthday is:

**June 10, 1819**

Courbet was a French painter associated with the Realism movement. This painting is currently held at the Musée d'Orsay in Paris.

(Note: There is also a book titled "Le ruisseau noir" written by Alain Lévêque and published in 1999, but the artwork by Gustave Courbet is the more prominent work associated with this title.)
